task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for OBS-05 at src/design/obs-05-dead-letter-queue.md. Define DLQ architecture and API contract end-to-end for failed SERVICE_TASK/webhook/timer processing that exceeds configurable retry limit N (default 3). Specify dead-letter item schema with required full context (original payload, instance_id, item_type, retry_count, error chain, timestamps, processor metadata), persistence lifecycle, and idempotency constraints. Design GET /dlq with API-06 pagination and filters (instance_id, item_type), deterministic ordering, and RBAC (PROCESS_OPERATOR or above). Design POST /dlq/:id/retry semantics including counter reset to 0, resubmission flow per item_type, transactional guarantees, and conflict handling for CANCELLED instances (HTTP 409 then discard behavior). Design POST /dlq/:id/discard semantics including permanent removal and mandatory audit append per OBS-03 with actor/action conventions. Include security, failure semantics, and requirement traceability matrix mapping every OBS-05 acceptance criterion and edge case to concrete modules/functions and test obligations. Design only; do not modify implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: All OBS-05 acceptance criteria and edge cases map to explicit design elements
DLQ data model, retry-limit transition rules, and full-context persistence are concrete and testable
GET /dlq, POST /dlq/:id/retry, and POST /dlq/:id/discard contracts include auth, pagination/filtering, ordering, and failure semantics
OBS-03 audit-on-discard requirements are explicitly integrated
Traceability matrix identifies module boundaries and verification hooks for implementation/testing

result.summary: Design artefact for OBS-05 dead letter queue completed at src/design/obs-05-dead-letter-queue.md, including full-context DLQ schema, retry-limit transition rules, GET/POST API contracts, CANCELLED-instance conflict behavior, idempotency and transaction guarantees, OBS-03 discard-audit integration, and a complete requirement-to-design traceability matrix.
